Name: NPC furniture - Penny's yellow and oak recolors
Author: Asterisk555
TagLine: Penny inspired furniture for Alternative Textures. Includes NPC furniture, recolours, and a few custom pieces.
Description:
Update: The textures in this mod have now been added to [NPC furniture and wallpaper](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13064)

_Instructions:_
Extract into mods folder.
Retexture items using paint bucket you can buy at Robin's

_Tips and Tricks:_
Some of the end tables will look cut off because you need to flip them and place them next to each other
Spouse room in the screenshot is [Toshinori](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6617). The children are [Eri](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6320) and [Izuku](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8977) from My Hero Academia.
See [Asterisk's Alternative Textures tools retexture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9984)  for a video on how to use AT tools in-game.
